questions.q: What does everyone who sits in the armchair and answers questions get?
o: Can choose one of the prizes
questions.e: In the video: "može izabrati neku od vrednih nagrada" — can choose one of the valuable prizes.

questions.q: Who gives the interviewee the feeling of home?
questions.e: In the video: "Cijela moja porodica" — my whole family.

questions.q: What would happen if everybody could wear pyjamas all day?
o: The world would be more comfortable
questions.e: In the video: "Svet bi bio udobnije mesto kada bi ljudi mogli po ceo dan da budu u pidžamama" — the world would be a more comfortable place if people could be in pyjamas all day.
In the video: "Poklon kartica, Extreme Intimo" — a gift card, Extreme Intimo.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.e: The speaker is "I" — 1st person singular: sednem.
The preposition na answering "where to?" takes the accusative: na fotelju.

questions.q: Imamo jedan mali poklon za ___, možete da izaberete.
questions.e: The preposition za takes the accusative: za vas.
The verb "to give" + to whom? takes the dative: vama.
